preflop_action: UTG opens 2.5bb, MP folds, CO calls, BTN calls, hero(SB) calls, BB folds
reasoning: AA top overpair on 8-5-3 rainbow, SB OOP 4-way (CO+BTN+UTG behind; SB acts first since UTG is opener-but-not-yet-flop-actor — actually SB acts first OOP). UTG is preflop aggressor (opened 2.5); UTG c-bet frequency on this dry low board ~70%. CO/BTN are flatted (range-capped: no AK/AA/KK/QQ from cold-call; mostly 88-JJ, AJs-AQs, suited connectors, suited broadway). SB cold-called from blinds → range similar to MP cold-call style (88-JJ/AQs/suited broadway/some connectors). Realization OOP in 4-way ≈ 0.75; AA's nut-overpair status makes raw equity vs combined villain ranges ~80%, effective ~60% after multi-villain pot-cascade losses if checked-through. Donk-leading AA from SB OOP in 4-way is a strong GTO frequency (~55-65% donk in solver for dry-low overpairs); CHECK induces UTG c-bet for check-call but exposes AA to free turn cards on 4-way pot (any J-A overcard creates pair-with-kicker threats from CO/BTN). 66% bet (~7bb of 11) charges all middle pair-with-draw combos (8-x, 5-x, low pairs continuing for set/equity), denies free draws to CO/BTN flatted ranges, and isolates pressure against UTG's wider c-bet zone. Adjacent alternatives: pure check ~35% frequency (mixable, but loses the 'protection' EV in 4-way); pure raise after villain bet is not the spot (no bet yet); FOLD obviously insane on AA.

preflop_action: UTG opens 2.5bb, hero(MP) 3-bets 9bb, CO calls, BTN calls, SB+BB fold, UTG calls
reasoning: KK in 4-way 3-bet pot on Qc9d4s two-tone, MP OOP after squeezing 9bb 3-bet (vs UTG-open). CO+BTN cold-called the 3-bet — range-capped to TT-JJ/AQs/suited connectors (NO AK/AA/KK that would 4-bet). UTG flat-called the 3-bet — also capped (range narrowed to TT-QQ-ish/AQ/some merged calls). The cap-vs-cap dynamic: hero's range is 3-bettor-strong (QQ+/AK/A5s-A2s bluffs); villains' ranges are flatter-range. KK ahead of all 3 villains' continuing combos (loses only to QQ in UTG's flat range, which is rare; AA they'd 4-bet). Board Qc9d4s two-tone connects to villains' ranges: CO/BTN have Q-x flat-suited combos, 9-x suited connectors, AQ-AQ-suited; UTG has Q-x flat. Bet 60% (~17 of 28) for value+protection: charges Q-x/9-x value, denies draws (FD on board), keeps villains in for stack commitment by turn. Check exposes KK to free turn cards on a board that becomes worse with A or J turn. The 4-way 3-bet pot dynamic dominates: cap-vs-cap means hero's overpair-leading bets get called wider than 2-way. Adjacent: pure CHECK ~25% mix (induce if hero believes UTG will lead OOP-like-3-bettor); RAISE doesn't apply; FOLD impossible.

preflop_action: UTG opens 2.5bb, HJ calls, CO calls, hero(BTN) facing closing decision
reasoning: QJs in BTN closing 3 villains preflop (UTG opener + HJ flat + CO flat). Suited broadway QJs has strong implied-odds equity in 4-way SRP IP: ~16% raw equity vs combined ranges, but implied-odds-adjusted realization in BTN-IP-closing ≈ 0.90 → effective ~14.5% (just over pot-odds need of 12%). Squeeze 3-bet to ~12bb has low fold equity: UTG's range is too strong to fold (TT+/AQ+ continue); HJ/CO's flat ranges include 88-TT, AJs-AQs, suited broadway, suited connectors — most won't fold to 12bb 3-bet. Net squeeze EV: marginal; the 30-40% folds rate × cold-call equity vs continuing combos is roughly break-even, but loses implied-odds equity from being capped to a 3-bet range. CALL realizes IP-closing-position equity: hero plays in position vs HJ/CO post-flop, can c-bet vs check-through patterns, can fold cheaply if board unfavorable. Per AMENDMENT 1 closing-action: 0 players behind (SB+BB fold-most-of-time vs 4-handed pot at this pricing). CALL is GTO frequency-dominant (~75%) per multi-way solver evidence. Adjacent: RAISE 3-bet ~20% mix (occasional pressure); FOLD too tight (clearly +EV peel given pot odds + implied odds).

preflop_action: UTG opens 2.5bb, hero(MP) calls, CO calls, BTN calls, SB+BB fold
reasoning: AK overcards on 9-4-2 rainbow facing UTG 25% c-bet, MP middle-position 4-way (CO+BTN behind). MP range-capped (no AK pre-3-bet? actually MP CAN have AK as cold-call mix; assume hero kept AK in flat range for balance — somewhat unusual but defensible). UTG c-bet range on dry low: TT-AA overpairs (high c-bet freq), some air bluffs (broadway misses), AK air. Equity AK vs UTG c-bet ≈ 32% (6 outs to top pair + SDV vs missed bluffs). Pot odds 2.5/15 ≈ 17% need; effective equity ~25% (after MP-OOP-relative-to-CO/BTN realization drop ≈ 0.75 → 24%). CO+BTN behind: range-capped flatted preflop, low overcall frequency on dry low. AK has ace-high SDV value vs UTG's air; the ace blocker further reduces villain AA+ combos. CALL realizes turn-pull + SDV vs UTG's missed bluffs. MEDIUM confidence because: (a) MP-with-AK-flat is non-canonical; (b) effective equity is marginally above pot-odds need; (c) CO/BTN behind add asymmetric multi-villain pressure if they overcall. Adjacent: FOLD ~35% mix (defensible if MP's range tightly excludes AK); RAISE thin (loses to UTG's value continues, charges no folds from CO/BTN's flatted-strong ranges).

preflop_action: CO opens 2.5bb, BTN calls, SB calls, hero(BB) calls
reasoning: 77 = top set on 7-4-3 two-tone diamonds. CO is preflop aggressor; BB hero OOP 4-way. Board is coordinated (FD + straight draws 5-6, 6-5, A-2-3-4-5 wheel). Set-on-coordinated-MW is the prototype 'must bet for protection' spot. Slow-play exposes 77 to: (a) FD completing (~25% per villain × 3 = ~50% combined probability one villain has FD that completes by river); (b) straight draws (5-6 OESD; 6-5 makes 3-4-5-6-7); (c) 2-pair completions from villains' 7-x ranges (rare since they didn't 3-bet). Equity realization for top set on coordinated MW ≈ 65% by river if checked through 4-way (catastrophic loss vs 80%+ pure equity); BET 66% (~6.5bb) preserves top-set value + denies free draws. Donk-bet from BB OOP into 3 villains is normally dominated but TOP SET is the canonical exception — protection EV outweighs the polar-range disadvantage. CO will face the bet with c-bet range (continues with sets/2-pair value + folds air); BTN/SB cold-callers continue with strong draws + made hands. Adjacent: pure check loses ~10-15% equity per the slowplay-cooler calculation; RAISE doesn't apply (no bet yet); FOLD impossible.
